42.notes: This 'SimplifiedSOLOv2' head predicts one shared per-pixel category map plus a single class-agnostic objectness mask per image -- it does NOT predict per-instance mask proposals the way real SOLOv2 or Mask R-CNN do. Semantic metrics are computed on the category head's native 16x16 grid (ResNet50 stride 32, no decoder) with GT downsampled to match, exactly as this repo's own evaluate_metrics() does -- NOT at the 512x512 resolution used for the other six models, so SOLOv2's mIoU/precision/recall/F1 are not directly resolution-comparable to the rest. Instance metrics below are *derived* pseudo-instances (connected components of the class map, area>=150px, confidence=mean class prob over the component), matching the visualization convention already used in train_solov2_clean.py's plot_sample_prediction_comparison. Treat SOLOv2 instance AP as a weaker, derived signal, not a native per-instance prediction like Mask R-CNN/YOLO11.
